papers.title: Kezek: Splitting Mono Two-Person Conversations into Per-Speaker Tracks for Full-Duplex Dialogue Data
papers.summary: Kezek separates a mono two-speaker conversation into per-speaker tracks while preserving timing and short replies, using a phase-insensitive speaker-fingerprint-guided two-voice activity model followed by a conditioned time-domain separator, and it improves short-reply retention, leakage, channel-swap, and runtime metrics over an open baseline.

papers.title: StrideWorld: Benchmarking Scene Rigidity and Action Consistency in Interactive Video World Model
papers.summary: StrideWorld is a benchmark that fixes references before motion to detect scene deformation and action inconsistency in interactive video world models, showing that most models deform scenes and only depth-scaled command models preserve composed routes.

papers.title: AVTR: Adaptive Multimodal Reasoning with Visual Imagination
papers.summary: Adaptive Visual-Textual Reasoning combines generative visual reflection with textual reasoning and learns to route between them per input, improving multimodal task accuracy while reducing inference latency.
